g.text: Notes
Roof: spec roof.profile full_curve eased into the 35.7 m notches; beyond the
humps held non-increasing to the 34.4 m tip (the fit's upturn at |u| 123 is an
end artefact). Centre arch: one photo, +-2 m (blue band). Symmetric by fit.
Facade from photos (reference only): glass wall on the departures curb (L3),
level-topped ~9.3 m below the crest; trusses exposed above; columns in front
of the glass, each branching into 4-6 members; canopy ~4.5-6 m above the curb,
its hangers on the 40-ft grid and at +-30 / +-90 ft; the hall ends ~19-21 m
short of each tip.
Not published: mullion module, fascia depth, canopy depth, the end-wall
outline, the lower building masses. They need SFO record drawings.
Hall width CONFLICT: 210 ft = 64.0 m [pub SEAONC] does not fit under the
measured 65.4-m roof east of the west wall (at most 61.0 m with the wall at
its westmost reading). Resolutions: the wall nearer the eave; the hall running
east under a lower roof (the measured east edge is a "fascia -> lower roof
fall"); or a wider roof (SOM concept sketch "866' x 260'"). Drawn: the
published width measured from the west wall, ending beyond the east eave.
